text_summary.english_description:
[StartBattle] On self and 1 ally that has the highest max HP: consume up to 20 [BloodDinner] and apply 1 [BloomingThornsRodionFirst] for every 10 [BloodDinner] this unit consumed (2 times per turn)
- Prioritizes <Bloodfiend> allies
- If the affected ally is a <Bloodfiend>, this unit applies 1 additional [BloomingThornsRodionFirst]
- If this unit failed to consume [BloodDinner], gain 5 [Laceration]
<style="highlight">[WhenUse] Coin Power +1 for every 6 [Laceration] on target (max 2)</style>
